name: Forst (Lausitz, Germany)
description: Horizontal tricolour of red, yellow and red, charged at the centre with the city arms of Forst (Lausitz) (a yellow lion on red).
history: Municipal flag of Forst (Lausitz); German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Forst (Lausitz) arms — yellow lion on red
